Drachiri Benefactor

Dragons are strongly influenced by their type. For verum drachiri, or true dragons, this ranges from everything to their biology, their magical influences, and their ancestral Curse of Greed. For other draconic ancestries and creatures, some of these traits are passed onto their drachenchild.

The Drachiri Benefactor table below behaves similarly to the Draconic Benefactor features in that a draconic affiliated character or creature bears the drachiri’s qualities, and even their curse. It affects your scale color, your appearance, certain capabilities and their elemental affiliations or domains, and if applicable the Curse of Greed your character experiences.

Playing Draconic Characters

Thematically, certain drachiri-influenced territories and cultures revolve around ideas and environments listed in the Domains, Aspects and Themes column, while mechanically, they are affiliated most strongly to the elements and energies listed in that column.

Anytime you gain a Drachiri Benefactor, you select a trait that is associated with them, as listed in the Elements & Energies column. While most draconic characters are only affiliated with one element, some options may grant you access to another trait, or even grant you an additional Benefactor (and thus, another trait in their Elements & Energies column). If an option would give you the same type of Benefactor, you can choose another trait in their list you do not have.

Despite this, a draconic character can only be attuned to one element at a time. For the purposes of features or options that require an attuned element and any option with the drachiri trait, you use that trait for all intents and purposes. You can substitute the damage types and traits of attacks and spells with the drachiri trait or similar draconic sources with that of your attuned trait. If your attuned trait is Vitality or Void, you deal their respective damage types, but not their healing. If you possess multiple traits, each day during your daily preparations, or whenever you take ten minutes to meditate (which can coincide with similar activities such as Refocusing or non-strenuous exploration activities) you can change your attuned element.

While not every draconic character is affected by the curse listed by their drachiri benefactor, some are partially influenced or have features or traits that parrot or exemplify it in some way. In this instance, this typically results in an appropriate set of Edicts and Anathemas that your character must or should abide by, associated to the respective curse. Work with your GM to create an appropriate pair for your character, based on their own or their culture’s interpretations.

Drachiri Breath Damage, Weapon Group & Saves

Not every drachiri breath weapon is the same. There is a typical alignment between their trait with a particular style of attack, and the table below highlights the weapon group affiliated with a given trait. Some options will ask you to select a saving throw affiliated with your breath weapon when you take them, while others might ask you to choose a saving throw when you use the option.
